bioconda.name: robust-pcst
bioconda.summary: Robust disease module mining via enumeration of diverse prize-collecting Steiner trees
bioconda.description:
ROBUST mines disease modules from a protein-protein interaction network and a
set of seed genes. It enumerates diverse prize-collecting Steiner trees that
connect the seeds and reports the nodes that recur across trees, written as
GraphML, CSV or an edge list.
